customManagers.description: PI-933: tool versions pinned inside a workflow run step. Renovate's built-in managers see action digests (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests above) and lockfiles, but never a version literal in shell — so a pinned security scanner would rot silently while every other dependency stayed current. The marker comment is what makes such a pin visible, and it is required: with no marker this manager matches nothing and the version freezes with no signal at all.
